item.title: Energy Department Closes $1.9 Billion Loan to Restart Duane Arnold Nuclear Plant
item.description: The U.S. Department of Energy’s Office of Energy Dominance Financing today announced the financial close of a loan of up to $1.9 billion to NextEra Energy to help finance the restart of the Duane Arnold Energy Center in Linn County, Iowa.
